name: CV / Resume Analysis - QA Engineer
description: Extraction rules and signal mappings for QA Engineer and Test Automation CVs/resumes. NOTE: Specific evidence mappings (regex patterns and maps_to composite keys) are stored within individual skill files under evidence.cv, NOT here. The validate_composite_keys.py script scans both locations to verify coverage.

quality_indicators: Measurable automation coverage increase (e.g., 'increased E2E regression coverage from 30% to 85%')
Reduction in test cycle time (e.g., 'reduced release testing cycle from 3 days to 45 minutes via CI/CD test sharding')
Defect escape rate improvements (e.g., 'decreased production bugs by 40% with Shift-Left API testing')
Architecting cross-browser test frameworks from scratch using Playwright or Cypress
Establishing performance testing baselines and SLA/SLO thresholds with k6 or JMeter

sections.notes: Skills listed without project context receive lower strength. Must be corroborated by GitHub or assessment.

quality_indicators: Links to public GitHub test automation repositories with CI/CD workflows and Allure reports
Demonstrated Page Object Model or custom test fixture design
Demonstrated contract testing (Pact) or service virtualization (WireMock)

recognized_certifications: ISTQB Certified Tester Advanced Level - Test Automation Engineer (CTAL-TAE)
ISTQB Certified Tester Advanced Level - Test Manager (CTAL-TM)
Playwright / Cypress Certified Test Automation Specialist

patterns.pattern: Built and maintained E2E test automation frameworks using Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium
Designed and executed manual test cases, exploratory charters, and regression suites
Automated REST / GraphQL API tests using Postman, Newman, or REST Assured
Implemented performance and load testing using k6 or Apache JMeter
Audited accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA) using axe-core or screen readers
Integrated automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) with test gating
Managed test cases and execution runs in TestRail, Zephyr, or JIRA
Established enterprise test strategy, quality KPIs (DRE, defect escape), and risk-based testing
Implemented visual regression testing with Percy or Applitools
Implemented contract testing with Pact or service virtualization with WireMock

important_notes: CV claims of '100% test coverage' should be verified through GitHub CI reports and actual test suite assertions
Differentiate dedicated QA experience from developer-written unit tests; look for cross-stack test leadership and quality governance
ISTQB certification without practical automation code receives baseline certification weight but requires code corroboration
